versos.grego: Ἐν ἐκείναις ταῖς ἡμέραις πάλιν πολλοῦ ὄχλου ὄντος καὶ μὴ ἐχόντων τί φάγωσιν, προσκαλεσάμενος τοὺς μαθητὰς λέγει αὐτοῖς

controles.web: In those days, when there was a very great multitude, and they had nothing to eat, Jesus called his disciples to himself, and said to them,
controles.kjv: In those days the multitude being very great, and having nothing to eat, Jesus called his disciples unto him, and saith unto them,
controles.livre: Naqueles dias, quando havia de novo uma multidão , e não tinham o que comer,  Jesus  chamou os discípulos a si, e disse-lhes:

versos.grego: Σπλαγχνίζομαι ἐπὶ τὸν ὄχλον, ὅτι ἤδη ἡμέραι τρεῖς προσμένουσίν μοι καὶ οὐκ ἔχουσιν τί φάγωσιν·

controles.web: “I have compassion on the multitude, because they have stayed with me now three days, and have nothing to eat.
controles.kjv: I have compassion on the multitude, because they have now been with me three days, and have nothing to eat:
controles.livre: Tenho compaixão da multidão, porque já há três dias que estão comigo, e não têm o que comer.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐὰν ἀπολύσω αὐτοὺς νήστεις εἰς οἶκον αὐτῶν, ἐκλυθήσονται ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ· καί τινες αὐτῶν ἀπὸ μακρόθεν εἰσίν.

controles.web: If I send them away fasting to their home, they will faint on the way, for some of them have come a long way.”
controles.kjv: And if I send them away fasting to their own houses, they will faint by the way: for divers of them came from far.
controles.livre: E se eu os deixar ir sem comer para suas casas desmaiarão no caminho; e alguns deles vieram de longe.

versos.grego: καὶ ἀπεκρίθησαν αὐτῷ οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ ὅτι Πόθεν τούτους δυνήσεταί τις ὧδε χορτάσαι ἄρτων ἐπ’ ἐρημίας;

controles.web: His disciples answered him, “From where could one satisfy these people with bread here in a deserted place?”
controles.kjv: And his disciples answered him, From whence can a man satisfy these men with bread here in the wilderness?
controles.livre: Os seus discípulos lhe responderam: De onde poderá alguém saciar estes de pão aqui no deserto?

versos.grego: καὶ ἠρώτα αὐτούς Πόσους ἔχετε ἄρτους; οἱ δὲ εἶπαν Ἑπτά.

controles.web: He asked them, “How many loaves do you have?”   They said, “Seven.”
controles.kjv: And he asked them, How many loaves have ye? And they said, Seven.
controles.livre: Jesus lhes perguntou: Quantos pães tendes? E eles disseram: Sete.

versos.grego: καὶ παραγγέλλει τῷ ὄχλῳ ἀναπεσεῖν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς· καὶ λαβὼν τοὺς ἑπτὰ ἄρτους εὐχαριστήσας ἔκλασεν καὶ ἐδίδου τοῖς μαθηταῖς αὐτοῦ ἵνα παρατιθῶσιν, καὶ παρέθηκαν τῷ ὄχλῳ.

controles.web: He commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground, and he took the seven loaves. Having given thanks, he broke them, and gave them to his disciples to serve, and they served the multitude.
controles.kjv: And he commanded the people to sit down on the ground: and he took the seven loaves, and gave thanks, and brake, and gave to his disciples to set before them; and they did set them before the people.
controles.livre: Então mandou à multidão que se sentassem no chão. Em seguida, tomou os sete pães, e tendo dado graças, partiu-os, e os deu a seus discípulos, para que os pusessem diante deles. E eles os puseram diante da multidão.

versos.grego: καὶ εἶχαν ἰχθύδια ὀλίγα· καὶ εὐλογήσας αὐτὰ εἶπεν καὶ ταῦτα παρατιθέναι.

controles.web: They had a few small fish. Having blessed them, he said to serve these also.
controles.kjv: And they had a few small fishes: and he blessed, and commanded to set them also before them.
controles.livre: E tinham uns poucos peixinhos, e havendo dado graças, disse que também os pusessem diante deles.

versos.grego: καὶ ἔφαγον καὶ ἐχορτάσθησαν, καὶ ἦραν περισσεύματα κλασμάτων ἑπτὰ σπυρίδας.

controles.web: They ate, and were filled. They took up seven baskets of broken pieces that were left over.
controles.kjv: So they did eat, and were filled: and they took up of the broken meat that was left seven baskets.
controles.livre: Eles comeram, e se saciaram; e levantaram, do que sobrou dos pedaços, sete cestos.

versos.grego: ἦσαν δὲ ὡς τετρακισχίλιοι. καὶ ἀπέλυσεν αὐτούς.

controles.web: Those who had eaten were about four thousand. Then he sent them away.
controles.kjv: And they that had eaten were about four thousand: and he sent them away.
controles.livre: Os que comeram eram quase quatro mil. Depois os despediu.

versos.grego: Καὶ εὐθὺς ἐμβὰς εἰς τὸ πλοῖον μετὰ τῶν μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ ἦλθεν εἰς τὰ μέρη Δαλμανουθά.

controles.web: Immediately he entered into the boat with his disciples, and came into the region of Dalmanutha.
controles.kjv: And straightway he entered into a ship with his disciples, and came into the parts of Dalmanutha.
controles.livre: E logo entrou no barco com os seus discípulos, e veio para a região de Dalmanuta.

versos.grego: Καὶ ἐξῆλθον οἱ Φαρισαῖοι καὶ ἤρξαντο συνζητεῖν αὐτῷ, ζητοῦντες παρ’ αὐτοῦ σημεῖον ἀπὸ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ, πειράζοντες αὐτόν.

controles.web: The Pharisees came out and began to question him, seeking from him a sign from heaven, and testing him.
controles.kjv: And the Pharisees came forth, and began to question with him, seeking of him a sign from heaven, tempting him.
controles.livre: Os fariseus vieram, e começaram a disputar com ele, pedindo-lhe sinal do céu, para o testar.

versos.grego: καὶ ἀναστενάξας τῷ πνεύματι αὐτοῦ λέγει Τί ἡ γενεὰ αὕτη ζητεῖ σημεῖον; ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, εἰ δοθήσεται τῇ γενεᾷ ταύτῃ σημεῖον.

controles.web: He sighed deeply in his spirit, and said, “Why does this generation seek a sign? Most certainly I tell you, no sign will be given to this generation.”
controles.kjv: And he sighed deeply in his spirit, and saith, Why doth this generation seek after a sign? verily I say unto you, There shall no sign be given unto this generation.
controles.livre: E ele, suspirando profundamente em seu espírito, disse: Por que esta geração pede um sinal? Em verdade vos digo, que não se dará sinal a esta geração.

versos.grego: καὶ ἀφεὶς αὐτοὺς πάλιν ἐμβὰς ἀπῆλθεν εἰς τὸ πέραν.

controles.web: He left them, and again entering into the boat, departed to the other side.
controles.kjv: And he left them, and entering into the ship again departed to the other side.
controles.livre: Então os deixou, voltou a embarcar , e foi para a outro lado do mar .

versos.grego: Καὶ ἐπελάθοντο λαβεῖν ἄρτους, καὶ εἰ μὴ ἕνα ἄρτον οὐκ εἶχον μεθ’ ἑαυτῶν ἐν τῷ πλοίῳ.

controles.web: They forgot to take bread; and they didn’t have more than one loaf in the boat with them.
controles.kjv: Now the disciples had forgotten to take bread, neither had they in the ship with them more than one loaf.
controles.livre: E os seus discípulos haviam se esquecido de tomar pão, e nada tinham, a não ser um pão com eles no barco.

versos.grego: καὶ διεστέλλετο αὐτοῖς λέγων Ὁρᾶτε, βλέπετε ἀπὸ τῆς ζύμης τῶν Φαρισαίων καὶ τῆς ζύμης Ἡρῴδου.

controles.web: He warned them, saying, “Take heed: beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and the yeast of Herod.”
controles.kjv: And he charged them, saying, Take heed, beware of the leaven of the Pharisees, and of the leaven of Herod.
controles.livre: E Jesus lhes deu a seguinte ordem: Prestai atenção: tende cuidado com o fermento dos fariseus e o fermento de Herodes.

versos.grego: καὶ διελογίζοντο πρὸς ἀλλήλους ὅτι ἄρτους οὐκ ἔχουσιν.

controles.web: They reasoned with one another, saying, “It’s because we have no bread.”
controles.kjv: And they reasoned among themselves, saying, It is because we have no bread.
controles.livre: E indagavam-se com os outros porque não tinham pão

versos.grego: καὶ γνοὺς λέγει αὐτοῖς Τί διαλογίζεσθε ὅτι ἄρτους οὐκ ἔχετε; οὔπω νοεῖτε οὐδὲ συνίετε; πεπωρωμένην ἔχετε τὴν καρδίαν ὑμῶν;

controles.web: Jesus, perceiving it, said to them, “Why do you reason that it’s because you have no bread? Don’t you perceive yet, neither understand? Is your heart still hardened?
controles.kjv: And when Jesus knew it, he saith unto them, Why reason ye, because ye have no bread? perceive ye not yet, neither understand? have ye your heart yet hardened?
controles.livre: Jesus  soube e lhes disse: Por que indagais que não tendes pão? Não percebeis ainda, nem entendeis? Tendes o vosso coração endurecido?

versos.grego: ὀφθαλμοὺς ἔχοντες οὐ βλέπετε, καὶ ὦτα ἔχοντες οὐκ ἀκούετε; καὶ οὐ μνημονεύετε,

controles.web: Having eyes, don’t you see? Having ears, don’t you hear? Don’t you remember?
controles.kjv: Having eyes, see ye not? and having ears, hear ye not? and do ye not remember?
controles.livre: Tendes olhos, e não vedes? Tendes ouvidos, e não ouvis?

versos.grego: ὅτε τοὺς πέντε ἄρτους ἔκλασα εἰς τοὺς πεντακισχιλίους, πόσους κοφίνους κλασμάτων πλήρεις ἤρατε; λέγουσιν αὐτῷ Δώδεκα.

controles.web: When I broke the five loaves among the five thousand, how many baskets full of broken pieces did you take up?”   They told him, “Twelve.”
controles.kjv: When I brake the five loaves among five thousand, how many baskets full of fragments took ye up? They say unto him, Twelve.
controles.livre: E não vos lembrais de, quando parti os cinco pães entre os cinco mil, quantos cestos cheios de pedaços levantastes?Responderam-lhe: Doze.

versos.grego: ὅτε τοὺς ἑπτὰ εἰς τοὺς τετρακισχιλίους, πόσων σπυρίδων πληρώματα κλασμάτων ἤρατε; καὶ λέγουσιν Ἑπτά.

controles.web: “When the seven loaves fed the four thousand, how many baskets full of broken pieces did you take up?”   They told him, “Seven.”
controles.kjv: And when the seven among four thousand, how many baskets full of fragments took ye up? And they said, Seven.
controles.livre: Quando parti os sete entre os quatro mil, quantas cestas cheias de pedaços levantastes? Eles disseram: Sete.

versos.grego: καὶ ἔλεγεν αὐτοῖς Οὔπω συνίετε;

controles.web: He asked them, “Don’t you understand, yet?”
controles.kjv: And he said unto them, How is it that ye do not understand?
controles.livre: Ele lhes perguntou: Ainda não entendeis?

versos.grego: Καὶ ἔρχονται εἰς Βηθσαϊδάν. Καὶ φέρουσιν αὐτῷ τυφλὸν, καὶ παρακαλοῦσιν αὐτὸν ἵνα αὐτοῦ ἅψηται.

controles.web: He came to Bethsaida. They brought a blind man to him, and begged him to touch him.
controles.kjv: And he cometh to Bethsaida; and they bring a blind man unto him, and besought him to touch him.
controles.livre: Então vieram a Betsaida. E trouxeram-lhe um cego, e rogaram-lhe que o tocasse.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐπιλαβόμενος τῆς χειρὸς τοῦ τυφλοῦ ἐξήνεγκεν αὐτὸν ἔξω τῆς κώμης, καὶ πτύσας εἰς τὰ ὄμματα αὐτοῦ, ἐπιθεὶς τὰς χεῖρας αὐτῷ, ἐπηρώτα αὐτόν Εἴ τι βλέπεις;

controles.web: He took hold of the blind man by the hand, and brought him out of the village. When he had spit on his eyes, and laid his hands on him, he asked him if he saw anything.
controles.kjv: And he took the blind man by the hand, and led him out of the town; and when he had spit on his eyes, and put his hands upon him, he asked him if he saw ought.
controles.livre: Ele tomou o cego pela mão e o tirou para fora da aldeia. Depois cuspiu nos olhos dele e, pondo as mãos encima dele, perguntou-lhe : Tu vês alguma coisa?.

versos.grego: καὶ ἀναβλέψας ἔλεγεν Βλέπω τοὺς ἀνθρώπους, ὅτι ὡς δένδρα ὁρῶ περιπατοῦντας.

controles.web: He looked up, and said, “I see men; for I see them like trees walking.”
controles.kjv: And he looked up, and said, I see men as trees, walking.
controles.livre: Ele levantou os olhos e disse: Vejo as pessoas; pois vejo como árvores que andam.

versos.grego: εἶτα πάλιν ἐπέθηκεν τὰς χεῖρας ἐπὶ τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς αὐτοῦ, καὶ διέβλεψεν καὶ ἀπεκατέστη, καὶ ἐνέβλεπεν τηλαυγῶς ἅπαντα.

controles.web: Then again he laid his hands on his eyes. He looked intently, and was restored, and saw everyone clearly.
controles.kjv: After that he put his hands again upon his eyes, and made him look up: and he was restored, and saw every man clearly.
controles.livre: Então Jesus pôs de novo as mãos sobre os seus olhos, e ele olhou atentamente. Assim ele ficou restabelecido, e passou a ver todos claramente.

versos.grego: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν αὐτὸν εἰς οἶκον αὐτοῦ λέγων Μηδὲ εἰς τὴν κώμην εἰσέλθῃς.

controles.web: He sent him away to his house, saying, “Don’t enter into the village, nor tell anyone in the village.”
controles.kjv: And he sent him away to his house, saying, Neither go into the town, nor tell it to any in the town.
controles.livre: Então o mandou para sua casa, dizendo: Não entres na aldeia.

versos.grego: Καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς καὶ οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ εἰς τὰς κώμας Καισαρίας τῆς Φιλίππου· καὶ ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ ἐπηρώτα τοὺς μαθητὰς αὐτοῦ λέγων αὐτοῖς Τίνα με λέγουσιν οἱ ἄνθρωποι εἶναι;

controles.web: Jesus went out, with his disciples, into the villages of Caesarea Philippi. On the way he asked his disciples, “Who do men say that I am?”
controles.kjv: And Jesus went out, and his disciples, into the towns of Cesarea Philippi: and by the way he asked his disciples, saying unto them, Whom do men say that I am?
controles.livre: Jesus saiu com os seus discípulos para as aldeias de Cesareia de Filipe; e no caminho perguntou a seus discípulos: Quem as pessoas dizem que eu sou?

versos.grego: οἱ δὲ εἶπαν αὐτῷ λέγοντες ὅτι Ἰωάνην τὸν Βαπτιστήν, καὶ ἄλλοι Ἡλείαν, ἄλλοι δὲ ὅτι εἷς τῶν προφητῶν.

controles.web: They told him, “John the Baptizer, and others say Elijah, but others: one of the prophets.”
controles.kjv: And they answered, John the Baptist: but some say, Elias; and others, One of the prophets.
controles.livre: Eles responderam: João Batista, e outros, Elias; e outros, algum dos profetas.

versos.grego: καὶ αὐτὸς ἐπηρώτα αὐτούς Ὑμεῖς δὲ τίνα με λέγετε εἶναι; ἀποκριθεὶς ὁ Πέτρος λέγει αὐτῷ Σὺ εἶ ὁ Χριστός.

controles.web: He said to them, “But who do you say that I am?”   Peter answered, “You are the Christ.”
controles.kjv: And he saith unto them, But whom say ye that I am? And Peter answereth and saith unto him, Thou art the Christ.
controles.livre: E ele lhes perguntou: E vós, quem dizeis que eu sou? Pedro lhe respondeu: Tu és o Cristo.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐπετίμησεν αὐτοῖς ἵνα μηδενὶ λέγωσιν περὶ αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: He commanded them that they should tell no one about him.
controles.kjv: And he charged them that they should tell no man of him.
controles.livre: E lhes ordenou que a ninguém dissessem aquilo dele.

versos.grego: Καὶ ἤρξατο διδάσκειν αὐτοὺς ὅτι δεῖ τὸν Υἱὸν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου πολλὰ παθεῖν, καὶ ἀποδοκιμασθῆναι ὑπὸ τῶν πρεσβυτέρων καὶ τῶν ἀρχιερέων καὶ τῶν γραμματέων καὶ ἀποκτανθῆναι καὶ μετὰ τρεῖς ἡμέρας ἀναστῆναι·

controles.web: He began to teach them that the Son of Man must suffer many things, and be rejected by the elders, the chief priests, and the scribes, and be killed, and after three days rise again.
controles.kjv: And he began to teach them, that the Son of man must suffer many things, and be rejected of the elders, and of the chief priests, and scribes, and be killed, and after three days rise again.
controles.livre: E começou a lhes ensinar que era necessário que o Filho do homem sofresse muito, e fosse rejeitado pelos anciãos e pelos chefes dos sacerdotes e escribas, e que fosse morto, e depois de três dias ressuscitasse.

versos.grego: καὶ παρρησίᾳ τὸν λόγον ἐλάλει. καὶ προσλαβόμενος ὁ Πέτρος αὐτὸν ἤρξατο ἐπιτιμᾶν αὐτῷ.

controles.web: He spoke to them openly. Peter took him, and began to rebuke him.
controles.kjv: And he spake that saying openly. And Peter took him, and began to rebuke him.
controles.livre: Ele dizia essa palavra abertamente. Então Pedro o tomou à parte, e começou a repreendê-lo.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ ἐπιστραφεὶς καὶ ἰδὼν τοὺς μαθητὰς αὐτοῦ ἐπετίμησεν Πέτρῳ καὶ λέγει Ὕπαγε ὀπίσω μου, Σατανᾶ, ὅτι οὐ φρονεῖς τὰ τοῦ Θεοῦ ἀλλὰ τὰ τῶν ἀνθρώπων.

controles.web: But he, turning around, and seeing his disciples, rebuked Peter, and said, “Get behind me, Satan! For you have in mind not the things of God, but the things of men.”
controles.kjv: But when he had turned about and looked on his disciples, he rebuked Peter, saying, Get thee behind me, Satan: for thou savourest not the things that be of God, but the things that be of men.
controles.livre: Mas Jesus virou-se e, olhando para os seus discípulos, repreendeu Pedro, dizendo: Sai de diante de mim, satanás! Pois tu não compreendes as coisas de Deus, mas sim as humanas.

versos.grego: Καὶ προσκαλεσάμενος τὸν ὄχλον σὺν τοῖς μαθηταῖς αὐτοῦ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Εἴ τις θέλει ὀπίσω μου ἐλθεῖν, ἀπαρνησάσθω ἑαυτὸν καὶ ἀράτω τὸν σταυρὸν αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἀκολουθείτω μοι.

controles.web: He called the multitude to himself with his disciples, and said to them, “Whoever wants to come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.
controles.kjv: And when he had called the people unto him with his disciples also, he said unto them, Whosoever will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.
controles.livre: Então chamou a si a multidão com os seus discípulos, e disse-lhes: Se alguém quiser me seguir, negue a si mesmo, tome a sua cruz, e siga-me;

versos.grego: ὃς γὰρ ἐὰν θέλῃ τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ σῶσαι, ἀπολέσει αὐτήν· ὃς δ’ ἂν ἀπολέσει τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ ἕνεκεν ἐμοῦ καὶ τοῦ εὐαγγελίου, σώσει αὐτήν.

controles.web: For whoever wants to save his life will lose it; and whoever will lose his life for my sake and the sake of the Good News will save it.
controles.kjv: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it; but whosoever shall lose his life for my sake and the gospel’s, the same shall save it.
controles.livre: pois quem quiser salvar a sua vida, a perderá; mas quem perder a sua vida por causa de mim e do Evangelho, esse a salvará.

versos.grego: τί γὰρ ὠφελεῖ ἄνθρωπον κερδῆσαι τὸν κόσμον ὅλον καὶ ζημιωθῆναι τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ;

controles.web: For what does it profit a man, to gain the whole world, and forfeit his life?
controles.kjv: For what shall it profit a man, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul?
controles.livre: Pois que proveito teria alguém, se ganhasse o mundo todo, e perdesse a sua alma?

versos.grego: τί γὰρ δοῖ ἄνθρωπος ἀντάλλαγμα τῆς ψυχῆς αὐτοῦ;

controles.web: For what will a man give in exchange for his life?
controles.kjv: Or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul?
controles.livre: Ou que daria alguém em resgate de sua alma?

versos.grego: ὃς γὰρ ἐὰν ἐπαισχυνθῇ με καὶ τοὺς ἐμοὺς λόγους ἐν τῇ γενεᾷ ταύτῃ τῇ μοιχαλίδι καὶ ἁμαρτωλῷ, καὶ ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἐπαισχυνθήσεται αὐτὸν, ὅταν ἔλθῃ ἐν τῇ δόξῃ τοῦ Πατρὸς αὐτοῦ μετὰ τῶν ἀγγέλων τῶν ἁγίων.

controles.web: For whoever will be ashamed of me and of my words in this adulterous and sinful generation, the Son of Man also will be ashamed of him, when he comes in the glory of his Father with the holy angels.”
controles.kjv: Whosoever therefore shall be ashamed of me and of my words in this adulterous and sinful generation; of him also shall the Son of man be ashamed, when he cometh in the glory of his Father with the holy angels.
controles.livre: Porque todo aquele que se envergonhar de mim e de minhas palavras nesta geração adúltera e pecadora, também o Filho do homem, quando vier na glória de seu Pai com os santos anjos, envergonhar-se-á dele.
